name: The Moonsilver Blade
summary: Trevan Rol asks you to bring him Ott's Masterwork in Silverpine Forest. The blade is the last part of his work before he faces a beast.

sections.title: The Blade
sections.body: Ott thanks you for the opportunity and asks you to pass his gratitude to Trevan. You carry Ott's Masterwork back to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: Trevan's Approval
sections.body: Trevan inspects the blade and approves of Ott's work. He says the only thing left is to kill the beast, and directs you to speak with Lumina when you are ready.

faq.answer: Ott made the blade and sent it with you to Trevan Rol.
Trevan Rol is the one who receives and inspects Ott's Masterwork in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Where do I bring the blade?
faq.answer: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What does Trevan think of the blade?
faq.answer: Trevan inspects the blade and says it will do nicely.

faq.q: Who should I speak with after Trevan?
faq.answer: Trevan directs you to speak with Lumina when you are ready.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Moonsilver Blade
